# Screen Sharing with Elderly Parents
I have elderly parents that occasionally need help on using their iMac. I live 3 time zones away so I need a solution that will enable me to log onto their computer and share their screen and actually work remotely. I have done some research and it appears their are some apps that provide this, but I am looking for a simple straightforward easy to use solution. Can any one advise?

## Similar questions
* 
EASY remote screen sharing for my momWhile recently trying to do a family zoom, my 90 year old mom couldn't connect because she needed to download the zoom update. She lives in a senior living facility that's still under COVID lockdown and is very un-tech savvy. I've spent over an hour trying to help her and I really need to be able to see what she's doing. But to do so, she needs to install or configure some type of extension/software, etc. I tried doing it various ways, including Messages, but that was never configured on her computer and doing so is not possible without me being to be able to see the screen. Her email is working however and I was wondering if there's some link I could email her that, when she clicks on it, would give me access. It would have to be very simple, like "click on this link and then click the give access button."
Any ideas?
9944

can my 2012 MacBook air screen share with a 2019I am used to screen sharing with my elderly father's computer. He just got a new MacBook air and I can no longer screen share. My computer is a MacBook Air 2012 with Catalina 10.15.2 He is up to date as well. Is the issue my old MacBook? Is there anyway to make me be able to screen share with him? I've made sure his computer would be accessible. Thanks for any advice.
4161
* 
Answer to remotely controlling elderly parents computersI have been controlling my elderly mother’s iMac after my father died with an app called SCREENS —you download the app onto the computer and you download the app onto your phone. I don’t know if you can download it onto an iPad or not. I am able to pull up Facebook and pull up her church services via Facebook and do ANYTHING on her computer. I literally get her computer screen on my phone and then I use my finger to control the cursor.
